description: This file contains a report script for TDS payable monthly report in ERPNext, including functions for data retrieval, validation, and report generation related to TDS deductions, suppliers, and GL entries.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates that the date filters are correctly set.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Processes GL entries and computes TDS deductions and amounts for the report.

methods.name: get_supplier_pan_map
methods.description: Retrieves supplier details including PAN, name, and tax category.

methods.name: get_gle_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of GL entries grouped by voucher number.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report output.

methods.name: get_tds_docs
methods.description: Fetches TDS-related documents and categorizes them by voucher type.

methods.name: get_tax_category_map
methods.description: Builds a map of vouchers to their tax withholding categories.

methods.name: get_tax_rate_map
methods.description: Retrieves applicable tax withholding rates based on date filters.
